questions.text: Explain the factors that led to the origin of agriculture during the New Stone Age (Neolithic Age).
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the factors that led to the origin of agriculture during the New Stone Age (Neolithic Age). (Difficult)

answer.value:
Key developments in human history
Scarcity of food for animals: Humans had to find new ways to obtain food.
Shift from nomadic lifestyle to settled agriculture: Humans began to cultivate crops and domesticate animals.
River valley civilizations: Early civilizations emerged in river valleys.
Agriculture became the foundation of culture and civilization: Agriculture allowed for settled life, which led to the development of complex societies.
Evidence of early agriculture in the Indian subcontinent: Archaeological sites like Mehrgarh in Pakistan provide evidence of early agriculture.

questions.text: What changes occurred due to the discovery of iron?
questions.text_as_printed: What changes occurred due to the discovery of iron? (Average)

answer.value:
Iron Age developments
Iron Age is also known as the Megalithic Age: The use of iron tools and megalithic structures characterized this period.
Iron tools and equipment aided agriculture and craft production: The introduction of iron tools improved agricultural productivity and craft production.
Agricultural activities flourished in North India: The use of iron tools and other technological advancements led to increased agricultural productivity.
Surplus production and emergence of a controlling class: The increased productivity led to surplus production, which in turn led to the emergence of a controlling class.
Emergence of republics and empires: The Mauryan and Nanda empires emerged during this period.

questions.text: Why do we need history? Explain in your own words.
questions.text_as_printed: Why do we need history? Explain in your own words. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Importance of history
History is the collective memory of a nation: It helps us learn from the past and make informed decisions about the future.
History provides lessons from the past: It teaches us about the successes and failures of our ancestors.
History inspires future generations: The stories of bravery, sacrifice, and achievement inspire future generations.
History helps us understand our culture and heritage: It provides a sense of identity and belonging.
